# Path-length vectors, EC P-256, all ecdsa-with-SHA256, validity 2020-01-01..2099-12-31, keys not stored. Every CA has CA:TRUE, keyCertSign, subject/authority key
# identifiers; every leaf has CN/SAN=localhost and EKU serverAuth+clientAuth.
#   root_cert (serial 1, self-signed) -> inter_1_cert .. inter_6_cert (serials 2..7, each issued by the one before) -> leaf_cert (serial 8, issued by inter_6_cert).
#     The leaf sits six CAs below the root; trusting inter_N_cert as the anchor leaves 6-N certificates between the leaf and the anchor.
#   rollover_a_cert (serial 9, issued by root_cert, "TlsLib Path Rollover CA") -> rollover_b_cert (serial 10, the same name over a new key, signed by
#     rollover_a_cert's key, so it is self-issued but not self-signed) -> rollover_leaf_cert (serial 11, issued by rollover_b_cert's key).
#     Two certificates sit between the leaf and root_cert, one of them self-issued.
#   cross_mid_cert (serial 12, issued by root_cert) and cross_issuer_long_cert (serial 13, issued by cross_mid_cert) / cross_issuer_short_cert (serial 14,
#     issued by root_cert): one name and key under two issuers. cross_leaf_cert (serial 15) is issued by that key: two certificates between it and
#     root_cert through the long issuer, one through the short.
# Generated with OpenSSL 3.2.1 (openssl ca -startdate 20200101000000Z -enddate 20991231000000Z; MSYS2_ARG_CONV_EXCL='*'):
#   openssl ecparam -name prime256v1 -genkey -noout -out X.key   (each certificate)
#   openssl req -new -key X.key -subj "/CN=<name>" -out X.csr    (names: TlsLib Path Root, TlsLib Path Issuer 1..6, localhost, TlsLib Path Rollover CA, TlsLib Path Cross Mid, TlsLib Path Cross Issuer)
#   openssl ca -batch -config ca.cnf -selfsign -in root.csr -keyfile root.key -startdate NB -enddate NA -extfile ca.ext -notext -out root.pem
#   openssl ca -batch -config ca.cnf -in X.csr -cert <issuer>.pem -keyfile <issuer>.key -startdate NB -enddate NA -extfile ca.ext -notext -out X.pem
#     ca.cnf: [ca] default_ca=c / [c] database=index.txt new_certs_dir=. serial=serial.txt default_md=sha256 policy=p unique_subject=no / [p] commonName=supplied
#     ca.ext: basicConstraints=critical,CA:true / keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign / subjectKeyIdentifier=hash / authorityKeyIdentifier=keyid
#     leaf.ext: basicConstraints=CA:false / keyUsage=critical,digitalSignature / extendedKeyUsage=serverAuth,clientAuth / subjectAltName=DNS:localhost / subjectKeyIdentifier=hash / authorityKeyIdentifier=keyid
#   openssl verify -CAfile root.pem -untrusted <the certificates between>: leaf, rollover_leaf and cross_leaf (through either issuer) all verify
#   openssl x509 -in X.pem -outform DER | xxd -p   (each field)
root_
inter_1_
inter_2_
inter_3_
inter_4_
inter_5_
inter_6_
leaf_
rollover_a_
rollover_b_
rollover_leaf_
cross_mid_
cross_issuer_long_
cross_issuer_short_
cross_leaf_
